top_choice_rationale: P001 (Buchwald and Hartwig, general ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling) is the only proposal where generality, characterised mechanism (Pd-amido intermediates, C-N reductive elimination, ligand effects), three decades of independent confirmation and a clean two-name allocation all hold. The citation scope, general and catalytic, protects against the Kosugi tin-amide precursor, and the C-N problem is a distinct elementary-step solution from the 2010 C-C prize. P002 is a mature and important science but its laureate allocation among Cullis, MacLachlan, Anderson, Hope, Madden and Langer is contested; it still ranks above no award.
